title: Sidecar
description: The terminal-centric workspace for AI coding agents.
provenance: Authored 2026-09-10 from the Sidecar codebase and documentation. Reviewed against internal implementation files and controlling docs. This model represents verified architecture and boundaries, not an exhaustive AST scan. Extended 2026-10-03 with the UI API host (sidecar api serve), the headless terminal protocol services, UI API clients and their trust boundaries, from internal/uiapi, internal/cli/api.go, internal/mobile, internal/mobilehub, docs/reference/ui-api.md and docs/plans/active/sidecar-ui-api.md. UI API elements without #proposed are U0 plus U1-a events as implemented in this tree. Events are verified by scripts/ui-api-proof.sh and event unit tests; client adoption and content invalidation remain proposed. Other #proposed elements are remaining U1 to U4 plan work. The sidecar-ui repository has no model of its own, so its packages are modeled here from the plan and wire contract rather than its source.

boundaries.title: Interactive TUI Client
boundaries.description: Bubble Tea frontend handling user input, focus, and cross-project navigation.

boundaries.title: Shared Layout Engine
boundaries.description: Split-tree geometry, border compositor, and live refresh shared across Workspaces and Sessions.

boundaries.title: Multiplexer & PTY Boundary
boundaries.description: Independent tmux server process providing headless terminal emulation, session recovery, and capture.

boundaries.title: Agent Lifecycle & Sandbox
boundaries.description: Coding agent execution in isolated PTYs with lifecycle tracking and guarded out-of-band control.

boundaries.title: Durable State & Recovery
boundaries.description: Persistent filesystem storage in ~/.config and ~/.local/state for crash recovery.

boundaries.title: Host Remoting & Protocols
boundaries.description: Encrypted SSH channels for remote host orchestration and for the mobile companion's terminal protocol over stdio.

boundaries.title: Your Unix-Socket Boundary
boundaries.description: Mode-0600 sockets and files under $STATE/api that only processes running as the user can open. Callers here are trusted like the tmux socket, with no auth, and only here can pairing codes be minted or origins paired.

boundaries.title: Loopback Browser Boundary
boundaries.description: 127.0.0.1:7861 is reachable by every page in every browser and by every local user and process. Host, Origin and mutation guards plus origin-bound bearer tokens and tickets are what separate the owner's paired browser and paired origins from everything else that can reach the port.

boundaries.title: Tailnet Boundary
boundaries.description: tailscaled terminates HTTPS and is the only process that can reach the 0600 tailnet socket, so its Tailscale-User-Login header is trusted there and nowhere else. The --tailnet-port loopback fallback drops that guarantee.

boundaries.title: SSH Boundary
boundaries.description: SSH authenticates the caller as the user before any protocol byte flows: the native app runs sidecar mobile serve --stdio, and the hub reaches remote owners with mobile serve --owner-only over validated host routes.
